newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains cattle markets remain quiet - feedyards.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains cattle markets remain quiet - feedyards.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet Tuesday morning, with scattered bids of $70.00 per cwt being passed, cattle feeders said.

Several feedlot managers said no buyers visited their lots Tuesday and did not expect buyer interest until Wednesday or Thursday. Showlists largely contain short-fed cattle weighing 1,100 to 1,150 lbs.
Many managers concentrated on shipping last week's sales or catching up on bookkeeping.
Feedlots continue to ship cattle sold last week. Some feedlots have shipped all of last week's sales, while others said cattle sold late in the week remain in the pens.
